'''Michael Krause''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 67 from Aachen, Ger. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

An electronics student in Aachen, he played from the game's first day. He was Red 67 in the Ralltiir region, from Aachen, Germany.<ref name="decsq-prof">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/krausemichael.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 67 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001023040949/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/krausemichael.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
